top.zh:
真拿你没办法，坐好喽。
那是纽约州纽约市布鲁克林巴克莱中心的全球总决赛舞台，一场足以载入英雄联盟与BLG队史的封神之战。场馆万众屏息，喧嚣与沉寂反复更迭，每一次极限操作、每一回团战拉扯，都是追梦路上最滚烫的注脚。漫长岁月浮沉逐梦，无数次折戟沉沙、无数回抱憾离场，命运无数次将破局的希望与重担，压在孤勇前行的BLG五人肩上。
他们是驰骋峡谷多年的无双精锐，对线、运营、大赛底蕴早已炉火纯青。常年游走于生死边缘，历经无数强敌冲击与高压BO5对局，他们早已习惯逆风扛局，在绝境之中寻找撕裂黑暗的微光，是无数召唤师心中永不低头的湛蓝壁垒。
这条全球总决赛之路跌宕滚烫，布满荆棘与考验。瑞士轮的坚韧坚守，淘汰赛的殊死一搏，直至巴克莱中心穹顶之下的巅峰争锋，一路跌撞前行、逆势而上。褪去往昔的急躁锋芒，如今的BLG沉稳笃定，没有浮夸的虚名，唯有千锤百炼的默契与千帆过尽的从容。Bin横刀立马的世一上锋芒，Xun从不失手的惩戒惊雷，Knight左手缔造的法王传奇，Viper打破常规的诡道箭雨，以及ON浴火重生的完美救赎——每一次果敢开团，都是重压之下的担当；每一波绝地反击，都是不甘宿命的抗争。
整场BO5胶着拉扯、惊心动魄，经济与人头交替攀升，大龙与高地局势反复反转，所有人都在等待最终的结局。当第四局敌方主堡水晶在轰鸣声中彻底碎裂，3比1的比分定格大屏，所有焦灼与坚守终有归宿。尘埃落定，胜负落定！
历经漫长岁月的蛰伏，跨过无数质疑与低谷，熬过无数彻夜磨砺，BLG终于跨过了眼前最后一座高山，在布鲁克林的寒夜里捧起了至高无上的召唤师杯。压抑多年的渴望尽数释然，长久的奔赴与坚守终得圆满。赛场欢呼与漫天金雨轰然炸裂，聚光灯尽数汇聚在他们身上，昔日饱受磨砺的追梦者，终于让世界仰望他们的名字。
一冠一念，岁岁逐光。这不止是一场3比1的酣畅胜利，更是意志与热爱的无上凯旋。寥寥数局巅峰对决，承载着五人多年的坚守与倔强，也圆满了无数追随者漫长的青春信仰，让所有踏过的荆棘、熬过的低谷，都化作捧杯时最耀眼的荣光。
top.en: I really can't do anything about you, sit tight. That was the Worlds stage at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York—a legendary battle that will go down in the history of League of Legends and BLG. The venue held its breath, noise and silence alternated, and every limit-test and teamfight skirmish was the hottest footnote on the road to chasing dreams. After years of ups and downs, countless failures and regrets, fate pressed the hope and burden of breaking the deadlock onto the shoulders of the five BLG players. They are elite warriors who have galloped through the Rift for years; their laning, macro, and tournament experience are already masterful. Having walked on the edge of life and death for years, experiencing countless strong enemies and high-pressure BO5s, they are used to carrying games in adversity, finding the glimmer of light in the darkness—they are the blue fortress that never bows in the hearts of countless summoners. This Worlds journey was turbulent and hot, full of thorns and tests. The persistence in the Swiss Stage, the life-and-death struggle in the knockout stage, until the peak showdown under the dome of the Barclays Center, they stumbled forward and rose against the trend. Shedding the impetuous edge of the past, the current BLG is steady and determined. No flashy fame, only the tacit understanding honed by thousands of trials and the composure of having seen it all. Bin's World's Best Top edge, Xun's never-missing Smite thunder, Knight's legendary mage status, Viper's unconventional arrow rain, and ON's perfect redemption from the ashes—every bold engage was a responsibility under pressure; every desperate counterattack was a resistance against fate. The entire BO5 was tense and thrilling, with gold and kills alternating, and the situation of Baron and base structures reversing repeatedly. Everyone was waiting for the final result. When the enemy nexus shattered in the roar in the fourth game and the 3-1 score was fixed on the big screen, all the anxiety and persistence finally had a destination. The dust settled, the winner was decided! After years of dormancy, crossing countless doubts and valleys, and enduring countless nights of grinding, BLG finally crossed the last mountain in front of them and lifted the Summoner's Cup in the cold night of Brooklyn. The suppressed desire of many years was released, and the long-term pursuit and persistence were finally fulfilled. The cheers in the arena and the golden rain exploded, and the spotlights gathered on them. The dream chasers who had been tempered in the past finally made the world look up at their names. One championship, one thought, chasing the light year after year. This is not just a 3-1 hearty victory, but the supreme triumph of will and love. A few peak duels carried the five people's years of persistence and stubbornness, and also fulfilled the long-term youth faith of countless followers, turning all the thorns they stepped on and the valleys they endured into the most dazzling glory when lifting the cup.

拿你没办法，坐好喽。
那是纽约州纽约市布鲁克林巴克莱中心的全球总决赛舞台，一场足以载入英雄联盟与BLG队史的封神之战。场馆万众屏息，喧嚣与沉寂反复更迭，每一次极限操作、每一回团战拉扯，都是追梦路上最滚烫的注脚。漫长岁月浮沉逐梦，无数次折戟沉沙、无数回抱憾离场，命运无数次将破局的希望与重担，压在孤勇前行的BLG五人肩上。
他们是驰骋峡谷多年的无双精锐，对线、运营、大赛底蕴早已炉火纯青。常年游走于生死边缘，历经无数强敌冲击与高压BO5对局，他们早已习惯逆风扛局，在绝境之中寻找撕裂黑暗的微光，是无数召唤师心中永不低头的湛蓝壁垒。
这条全球总决赛之路跌宕滚烫，布满荆棘与考验。瑞士轮的坚韧坚守，淘汰赛的殊死一搏，直至巴克莱中心穹顶之下的巅峰争锋，一路跌撞前行、逆势而上。褪去往昔的急躁锋芒，如今的BLG沉稳笃定，没有浮夸的虚名，唯有千锤百炼的默契与千帆过尽的从容。Bin横刀立马的世一上锋芒，Xun从不失手的惩戒惊雷，Knight左手缔造的法王传奇，Viper打破常规的诡道箭雨，以及ON浴火重生的完美救赎——每一次果敢开团，都是重压之下的担当；每一波绝地反击，都是不甘宿命的抗争。
整场BO5胶着拉扯、惊心动魄，经济与人头交替攀升，大龙与高地局势反复反转，所有人都在等待最终的结局。当第四局敌方主堡水晶在轰鸣声中彻底碎裂，3比1的比分定格大屏，所有焦灼与坚守终有归宿。尘埃落定，胜负落定！
历经漫长岁月的蛰伏，跨过无数质疑与低谷，熬过无数彻夜磨砺，BLG终于跨过了眼前最后一座高山，在布鲁克林的寒夜里捧起了至高无上的召唤师杯。压抑多年的渴望尽数释然，长久的奔赴与坚守终得圆满。赛场欢呼与漫天金雨轰然炸裂，聚光灯尽数汇聚在他们身上，昔日饱受磨砺的追梦者，终于让世界仰望他们的名字。
一冠一念，岁岁逐光。这不止是一场3比1的酣畅胜利，更是意志与热爱的无上凯旋。寥寥数局巅峰对决，承载着五人多年的坚守与倔强，也圆满了无数追随者漫长的青春信仰，让所有踏过的荆棘、熬过的低谷，都化作捧杯时最耀眼的荣光。

top.en:
Nowhere to run, sit tight.
That was the Worlds stage at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York City, a legendary battle destined to be etched into the history of League of Legends and BLG. The arena held its breath as roaring cheers and dead silence alternated; every outplay and every teamfight dance was the most fervent footnote on the road of chasing dreams. Through long years of ups and downs, countless shattered ambitions and regretful exits, fate time and again pressed the hope and burden of breaking the curse onto the shoulders of the five fearless men of BLG.
They are elite veterans who have galloped across Summoner's Rift for years; their laning, macro, and tournament pedigree were already perfected. Wandering constantly on the edge of life and death, enduring relentless onslaughts from formidable foes and high-pressure Bo5s, they long ago grew accustomed to carrying the game against the wind, searching for a glimmer of light to tear through the darkness—the unyielding azure bastion in the hearts of countless summoners.
This Worlds road was turbulent, scorching, and paved with thorns and trials. The gritty endurance of the Swiss stage, the do-or-die battles of the knockout rounds, all the way to the peak clash beneath the dome of the Barclays Center—they stumbled forward, rising against the current. Shedding the hasty sharpness of the past, today's BLG is steady and resolute, free of flashy vanity, armed only with battle-forged synergy and hard-earned composure. Bin's unyielding stance as the best top laner in the world, Xun's infallible thunder-like Smites, Knight's legendary magecraft, Viper defying convention with a devious storm of arrows, and ON's fiery rebirth into a flawless redemption—every bold engage was a display of duty under pressure, and every desperate counter-attack an unyielding defiance against destiny.
The entire Bo5 was a gripping, tangled tug-of-war, with gold and kills trading hands, and Barons and base turrets flipping back and forth. Everyone was waiting for the final verdict. When the enemy nexus finally shattered with a deafening roar in game four, and the 3-1 score locked onto the big screen, all that tension and perseverance found its home. The dust settled, the victor was crowned!
After years of dormancy, overcoming endless doubts and valleys, enduring countless sleepless nights of grinding, BLG finally crossed the final mountain before them, lifting the supreme Summoner's Cup in the cold Brooklyn night. Years of pent-up desire were released, and the long journey of pursuit finally reached its wholesome completion. Stadium cheers and golden rain burst forth, all spotlights converging on them as the once-scorned dreamers finally made the world look up to their names.
Every championship a conviction, chasing the light year after year. This was more than just a 3-1 cathartic victory—it was the supreme triumph of willpower and passion. A handful of peak showdowns carried five years of perseverance and stubborn grit, fulfilling the long-standing faith of countless followers, turning every trampled thorn and weathered valley into the most dazzling glory upon lifting the cup.

top.en: I'm writing this between games 3 and 4. As a 9-year BLG fan, 11-year LPL fan, and 12-year LoL player, I fell in love with this team on December 18, 2017, the day BLG officially announced they were acquiring IM to build the roster. Because of [~0:Bilibili], I fell in love with this team, and before I knew it, nine whole years have passed. In these nine years, I've witnessed all of BLG's ups and downs. From the [~1:first love] of 2019, to the series of moves in '21/'22 that nearly made me [~2:quit the fandom], to the fresh look in '23, the [~3:narrow miss] in '24, the growing pains of '25, and finally, returning to the biggest stage this year to reclaim the glory we lost two years ago! Even though I'm writing this while BLG is up 2-1 against GenG, I've always believed in them, believed in the players I love, believed in the team I support, believed in the region I support, and believed in the game I'm passionate about. Not just for the five best guys on the stage this year, not just for BLG, not just for the LPL, but for myself. I don't even know what to say anymore; a thousand words can only be summed up in one sentence: Congratulations BLG!!!

notes.context: A self-deprecating nickname for the video platform Bilibili, which owns the BLG team.
An idiom referring to an idealized, unattainable, or nostalgic first love.
To stop being a fan of someone or something.
To lose due to a single mistake or a slight miscalculation.

top.zh:
真拿你没办法，坐好了，这里是纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心。北京时间11月15日凌晨三点，场馆灯火灼亮，全场的欢呼几乎要掀翻穹顶，这是S16全球总决赛最终的决战。
 屏幕前无数守到深夜的观众，心里都清楚这条道路有多疯狂。BLG从瑞士轮的悬崖边起步，一路闯关，先后斩落HLE、DK、T1，此刻站在最后一关，对手是GEN。在此之前，从来没有队伍能在同一届S赛里，连续碾碎四支LCK战队，一穿四，是只存在于幻想里的奇迹。
 他们身上驮着沉甸甸的过往：S14决赛擦肩而过的遗憾，屡次对阵LCK强队时背负的质疑，Knight沉淀许久的执念，Bin无数次绝境里站出来的担当。就算已经跨过三座大山，依旧很少有人敢相信，他们能走完这最后一步。外界的论调从未停歇，所有人都在等着GEN守住LCK最后的防线。
 技能碰撞的声响、指挥急促的呼喊、防御塔碎裂的轰鸣，填满了整场BO5。没有人敢提前松一口气，每一波团战都牵着亿万观众的心。
 四局鏖战落幕，比分停在掷地有声的3:1。
 BLG拿下了这场胜利。HLE、DK、T1、GEN，四支LCK强队尽数败于他们手下。他们完成了史无前例的一穿四，冲破所有定论与枷锁，在巴克莱中心，捧起召唤师奖杯，写下属于LPL崭新的传奇。
top.en: I really can't do anything with you. Sit tight, we are at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. It's 3:00 AM Beijing time on November 15th. The arena lights are blazing, the cheers are deafening, and this is the final showdown of the S16 [~0:Worlds]. Countless viewers watching through the night know how insane this journey has been. BLG started from the edge of the cliff in the [~1:Swiss stage], fighting their way through, taking down HLE, DK, and T1. Now they stand at the final gate, facing GEN. Never before has a team crushed four LCK teams in a single [~0:Worlds]—a 'one-through-four' run that was only a fantasy. They carry the weight of the past: the regret of missing out in the S14 finals, the doubts faced whenever playing against LCK powerhouses, Knight's long-held obsession, and Bin's willingness to step up in desperate situations. Even after crossing three mountains, few dared to believe they could take this final step. The outside noise never stopped; everyone was waiting for GEN to hold the LCK's final line of defense. The sound of abilities clashing, the frantic calls of the shotcallers, and the roar of crumbling turrets filled the BO5. No one dared to breathe easy; every teamfight held the hearts of millions. Four games of battle conclude, the score frozen at a resounding 3:1. BLG has secured the victory. HLE, DK, T1, GEN—four LCK powerhouses have all fallen to them. They completed an unprecedented 'one-through-four,' breaking through all predictions and shackles to lift the Summoner's Cup at the Barclays Center, writing a new legend for the LPL.

那是纽约州纽约市布鲁克林巴克莱中心的全球总决赛舞台，一场足以载入英雄联盟与BLG队史的封神之战。场馆万众屏息，喧嚣与沉寂反复更迭，每一次极限操作、每一回团战拉扯，都是追梦路上最滚烫的注脚。漫长岁月浮沉逐梦，无数次折戟沉沙、无数回抱憾离场，命运无数次将破局的希望与重担，压在孤勇前行的BLG五人肩上。
他们是驰骋峡谷多年的无双精锐，对线、运营、大赛底蕴早已炉火纯青。常年游走于生死边缘，历经无数强敌冲击与高压BO5对局，他们早已习惯逆风扛局，在绝境之中寻找撕裂黑暗的微光，是无数召唤师心中永不低头的湛蓝壁垒。
这条全球总决赛之路跌宕滚烫，布满荆棘与考验。瑞士轮的坚韧坚守，淘汰赛的殊死一搏，直至巴克莱中心穹顶之下的巅峰争锋，一路跌撞前行、逆势而上。褪去往昔的急躁锋芒，如今的BLG沉稳笃定，没有浮夸的虚名，唯有千锤百炼的默契与千帆过尽的从容。Bin横刀立马的世一上锋芒，Xun从不失手的惩戒惊雷，Knight左手缔造的法王传奇，Viper打破常规的诡道箭雨，以及ON浴火重生的完美救赎——每一次果敢开团，都是重压之下的担当；每一波绝地反击，都是不甘宿命的抗争。
整场BO5胶着拉扯、惊心动魄，经济与人头交替攀升，大龙与高地局势反复反转，所有人都在等待最终的结局。当第四局敌方主堡水晶在轰鸣声中彻底碎裂，3比1的比分定格大屏，所有焦灼与坚守终有归宿。尘埃落定，胜负落定！
历经漫长岁月的蛰伏，跨过无数质疑与低谷，熬过无数彻夜磨砺，BLG终于跨过了眼前最后一座高山，在布鲁克林的寒夜里捧起了至高无上的召唤师杯。压抑多年的渴望尽数释然，长久的奔赴与坚守终得圆满。赛场欢呼与漫天金雨轰然炸裂，聚光灯尽数汇聚在他们身上，昔日饱受磨砺的追梦者，终于让世界仰望他们的名字。
一冠一念，岁岁逐光。这不止是一场3比1的酣畅胜利，更是意志与热爱的无上凯旋。寥寥数局巅峰对决，承载着五人多年的坚守与倔强，也圆满了无数追随者漫长的青春信仰，让所有踏过的荆棘、熬过的低谷，都化作捧杯时最耀眼的荣光。

Nothing I can do about you, sit tight.
This was the Worlds stage at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York—a legendary battle destined to be etched into the history of League of Legends and BLG. The arena held its breath as the crowd's roar ebbed and flowed; every limit-test and every teamfight dance served as a scorching footnote on the road to a dream. After years of ups and downs, countless failures, and heartbreaking exits, fate finally placed the hope and burden of breaking the curse on the shoulders of the five BLG players.
They are elite veterans who have dominated the Rift for years, with laning, macro, and tournament pedigree already perfected. Having walked the edge of life and death for so long, and weathered countless high-pressure BO5s against formidable foes, they are accustomed to carrying games from behind, finding that glimmer of light to tear through the darkness—they are the blue bastion that never bows in the hearts of countless Summoners.
The road to Worlds was turbulent and scorching, filled with thorns and trials. From the 0:Swiss stage grind to the do-or-die knockout matches, all the way to the peak clash under the dome of the Barclays Center, they stumbled forward and rose against the tide. Shedding their former impatience, the current BLG is steady and determined, devoid of flashy vanity, possessing only the chemistry forged through fire and the composure of those who have seen it all. Bin, the world's best top laner standing tall; Xun, the jungler whose Smite never misses; Knight, the legendary mid laner; Elk, the ADC who breaks conventions with his arrows; and ON, the support who found his perfect redemption through fire—every decisive engage was a display of responsibility under pressure; every desperate counter-attack was a struggle against destiny.
The entire BO5 was a tense, heart-pounding tug-of-war, with gold and kills seesawing, and the momentum of Baron and base defenses flipping repeatedly. Everyone was waiting for the final outcome. When the enemy Nexus shattered with a roar in Game 4 and the 3-1 score locked onto the big screen, all the anxiety and persistence finally found their home. The dust settled, the winner was decided!
After years of dormancy, overcoming countless doubts and valleys, and enduring endless nights of grinding, BLG finally crossed the last mountain in front of them, lifting the supreme Summoner's Cup in the cold Brooklyn night. Years of suppressed desire were finally released; the long journey and persistence were finally fulfilled. As the cheers and golden rain exploded, the spotlights converged on them—the dreamers who had suffered so much finally made the world look up to their names.
One championship, one obsession, chasing the light year after year. This was more than just a satisfying 3-1 victory; it was the supreme triumph of will and passion. These few peak-level games carried the persistence and stubbornness of the five players over the years, fulfilling the long-held faith of countless followers, turning every thorn they stepped over and every valley they endured into the most dazzling glory at the moment of lifting the trophy.

From the 'white moonlight' of 2019, to the series of moves in 21/22 that almost made me quit, to the fresh look in 23, the 'so close yet so far' of 24, the growing pains of 25, and finally returning to the biggest stage this year to reclaim the glory lost two years ago! Even though I'm writing this while BLG is 2-1 up against Gen.G, I've always believed in them, in the players I love, the team I support, the region I back, and the game I'm passionate about. Not just for the five best guys on the stage this year, not just for BLG, not just for the LPL, but for myself. top.zh:
五年无冠海云黄，万里中原半夕阳。 春到南溟折桂返，金杯初照浦江长。

五月三韩战五场，功亏一篑大田旁。 七月西戎青旗折，归来帐下议更张。

副车初出试霜刃，数战不利军心震。 夜半将军自上书，明朝复领前锋印。

秋来决战沪江滨，同袍一战失龙鳞。 屈居次席出函谷，回首故园泪沾巾。

瑞士轮前风色恶，初战折锋众心愕。 同袍再战又相残，二胜二负悬一发。

背水一战气如虹，连下两城势若龙。 八强三捷青旗倒，四强一鼓旧王空。

上将三度临绝顶，前两度兮皆断肠。 白虎低头献金印，四破韩营天下扬。

五年饮恨今朝雪，十三旧捷一夜亡。 黄浦潮生连天起，尽是少年凯歌章。
top.en: Five years without a title, the sun sets over the Central Plains. Spring returns to the Southern Sea, the golden cup shines on the Huangpu River. Five battles in Korea in May, falling just short near Daejeon. In July, the western expedition's banners fell, returning to discuss new strategies. The deputy car first tested its frosty blade, several losses shook the army's heart. At midnight the general wrote his own letter, the next morning he led the vanguard again. Autumn decisive battle on the Huangpu, brothers lost their dragon scales in one fight. Settling for second place, leaving the Hangu Pass, looking back at home with tear-stained clothes. The wind was fierce before the Swiss stage, the first battle broke the blade and shocked everyone. Brothers fought again and turned on each other, two wins and two losses hanging by a thread. A desperate fight with spirit like a rainbow, taking two cities in a row with the momentum of a dragon. Three wins in the quarterfinals to topple the blue flags, one drum in the semifinals to clear out the old kings. The general reached the peak three times, the first two were heartbreaking. The White Tiger bowed its head to offer the golden seal, four victories over the Korean camp, famous throughout the world. Five years of regret washed away today, thirteen years of old victories gone in a night. The tide rises on the Huangpu, all are songs of youth's triumph.

top.zh:
朴载赫，今年是我看你比赛的第十年了。记得小时候第一次接触英雄联盟，从来没有玩过这款游戏但是却喜欢看激烈的打斗场面觉得很有意思。那年你初登赛场，身旁有许多大哥带着你一路前行，但在决赛倒在了大魔王的手下。人们记住了那个无所不能的faker，但我却觉得你呆萌的面庞很有亲和力。
我开始尝试去游玩英雄联盟，一开始也想玩adc，但我发现这游戏对于幼小的我也太难了，坐在椅子上勉强够得到的键盘和鼠标却没法像你一样用点击精准命中每一个想命中的目标。后来那年，你们又杀了回来，在北京鸟巢一战成名掀翻了不可一世的skt王朝，即使你争议性的拿到了fmvp，但身旁的大哥们却一脸欣慰的注视你，因为他们知道三星后继有人了，你就是天生注定继承他们火把的那个人。
再到后来，亚运会你代表韩国为国出征，却在决赛被巅峰的uzi正面击溃，我一方面为国家取得了金牌而感到高兴，另一方面却担忧我喜欢的你是否会就此一蹶不振。好在你就像你的id一样，如一把尺子一样时刻丈量着自己的实力与竞技状态。你没有就此沉沦或者抛弃自己，因为我相信你也知道从某一刻起ruler不再仅仅是一个普通玩家的id，它更是一些人的偶像，一些人的精神寄托，一些人生命前行的一座海上灯塔。即使时常在合同到期的时候收到来自其他俱乐部的天价邀约，你也选择了忠守于培育你的三星。即使身旁的老大哥一个接一个的离去，越来越多的新面孔取代了他们的位置，你也愿意挺身而出接下复兴三星的重任，数十年如一日的在游戏里尽情挥洒你的天赋与汗水。当我成长的路上每每遇到挫折想要后退的时候，脑海里总是有你那句不管如何都要坚持下去的声音，我想，这正是你赋予ruler这个id的意义吧。
今天比赛结束了，你出道后的第十年也结束了。我不会攻击你的任何一个队友，我想人能不能取得成功或许是命中注定的吧，有的人天生注定能够一直坚持取得成功，有的人的人生可能注定颠沛流离曲折离奇。正像你赛后做的一样，你主动站出来承担了责任，没有批评任何一个队员，而是作为老将替他人承担了压力与失利，正如十年前身旁的ambition皇冠哥等人一样，他们也并未责怪表现不佳的你，而是替你挡住了压力，希望你能在他们的庇护下茁壮成长。你终究没有辜负他们的信任，今天你的成功不仅仅是游戏内容的成功，更是赛场外的成长与信念。你真的做到了，虽然在今天你没有取得世俗意义上的成功，但你已经拼尽你的全力做到了最好，你无愧于观众，无愧于粉丝，最重要的是，你无愧于自己这么多年来的坚持与努力。
我想，我还是会接着喜欢你，喜欢你的率真，喜欢你的坚持，希望你不管今后是否还继续职业生涯，你也要喜欢你自己，因为你已经战胜了命运，战胜了自己。

top.en:
Park Jae-hyuk, this is my tenth year watching your matches. I remember when I first encountered League of Legends as a kid, having never played the game before but loving to watch the intense fights because I thought they were so interesting. That year you debuted on the stage, with many big brothers guiding you forward step by step, but you fell in the finals at the hands of the Demon King. People remembered that omnipotent Faker, but I felt your cute, naive face was very approachable.
I started trying to play League of Legends, initially wanting to play ADC, but I found this game was way too hard for little me. Sitting in a chair, barely able to reach the keyboard and mouse, I couldn't precisely hit every target I wanted with a click like you could. Later that year, you guys came back hard, making a name for yourselves at the Beijing Bird's Nest and turning over the unassailable SKT dynasty. Even though you arguably won the FMVP, the older brothers beside you looked at you with gratified satisfaction, because they knew GEN had a successor, and you were the one destined to inherit their torch.
Later on, at the Asian Games, you represented South Korea to fight for your country, only to be crushed head-on in the finals by Uzi at his peak. On one hand, I was happy my country won the gold medal, but on the other, I worried whether the you I liked would never recover from this. Fortunately, just like your ID, you always measured your own strength and competitive form like a ruler. You didn't sink into despair or give up on yourself, because I believe you also knew that from a certain moment on, Ruler was no longer just the ID of an ordinary player, but an idol to some, a spiritual sustenance to others, and a maritime lighthouse guiding people forward in life. Even when frequently receiving sky-high offers from other clubs as your contract expired, you chose to remain loyal to the GEN that nurtured you. Even as the older brothers beside you left one by one, replaced by a growing number of new faces, you were still willing to step up and take on the heavy responsibility of reviving GEN, spending decades like a single day pouring your talent and sweat into the game without reservation.
Whenever I encountered setbacks and wanted to retreat on my own growth journey, your voice telling me to press on no matter what always echoed in my mind. I think this is precisely the meaning you bestowed upon the ID Ruler.
Today's match has ended, and the tenth year since your debut has ended too. I won't attack any of your teammates; I suppose whether a person achieves success is perhaps predestined. Some people are destined to keep pushing forward and achieve success, while others are destined to lead a wandering and twists-and-turns life. Just like what you did after the match, you took the initiative to step up and shoulder the responsibility, not criticizing a single teammate, but acting as a veteran to take on the pressure and defeat for others. Just like Ambition, Crown, and the others beside you ten years ago, they didn't blame a underperforming you either, but instead blocked the pressure for you, hoping you could grow up strong under their protection. In the end, you didn't fail their trust; your success today isn't just a success within the game, but growth and conviction outside the arena. You really pulled it off. Even though you didn't achieve worldly success today, you gave it your all to do your absolute best. You have no shame before the audience, no shame before your fans, and most importantly, no shame before your own years of persistence and hard work.
I think I'll keep liking you, liking your candor and your persistence. I hope that regardless of whether you continue your pro career moving forward, you'll love yourself too, because you've already conquered fate and conquered yourself.

警情通报
 
2026年11月15日，纽约曼哈顿赛区赛事场馆更衣室发生一起恶性伤人案件，造成四人重伤不治、一人被依法控制的闹剧性刑事案件。
 
经查，涉案人员朴载赫（游戏ID：Ruler），系GEN.G俱乐部职业电竞选手。当日国际赛事总决赛结束后，GEN.G战队遗憾错失总冠军。嫌疑人朴载赫因赛后心态彻底失控，主观认定队内四名队友赛场发挥严重失常、操作拉胯，是战队痛失冠军的核心原因，心生极度不满与怨念。
 
在赛事结束、工作人员离场后，朴载赫于战队专属更衣室内，持随身棒球棍对队内四名队友实施殴打行为，击打部位涵盖躯干、四肢等多处位置。现场工作人员察觉异常破门制止时，四名被害队友已失去生命体征，现场留有棒球棍、赛后赛事复盘记录、战败成绩单等完整物证。
 
案发后，纽约警方第一时间抵达现场开展封锁勘查、物证提取、笔录固定等侦查工作，当场将犯罪嫌疑人朴载赫抓捕归案。经初步审讯，朴载赫对自己因队友发挥不佳、情绪过激伤人的犯罪事实供认不讳，全程直言“带不动、实属无奈”，认罪态度“摆烂且理直气壮”。
 
目前，该案件正在进一步侦办中。另据最新消息，韩国相关机构已正式向美方提交申请，为嫌疑人朴载赫申请无罪保释，理由为“全队实力差距过大，选手情绪失控情有可原，属于被动过激行为”，该申请暂未得到纽约警方批复。
 
警方郑重提示：电竞娱乐重在参与，胜负皆是常态。切勿因赛事输赢滋生极端情绪，更不可实施暴力伤人行为，一切过激违法行径，均将受到法律的严厉制裁。请勿模仿过激行为，理性观赛、理性竞技！
 
纽约市布鲁克林警察局
2026年11月15日
top.en:
Police Incident Report On November 15, 2026, a violent assault occurred in the locker room of the tournament venue in Manhattan, New York, resulting in a farcical criminal case where four people suffered severe, fatal injuries and one suspect was taken into custody according to the law. Upon investigation, the suspect Park Jae-hyuk (in-game ID: Ruler) is a professional esports player for the GEN.G club. Following the conclusion of the international tournament grand finals that day, GEN.G regrettably missed out on the championship. Suspect Park Jae-hyuk suffered a complete mental breakdown post-match, subjectively concluding that his four teammates performed abysmally on stage and threw with terrible plays, making them the core reason the team lost the title, which filled him with extreme resentment and grievance. After the event concluded and staff had left, Park Jae-hyuk used a baseball bat he brought along to assault his four teammates inside the team's exclusive locker room, striking areas including their torsos and limbs. When on-site staff noticed anomalies and broke through the door to stop him, the four victimized teammates had already lost their vital signs. Complete physical evidence including the baseball bat, post-match VOD review logs, and the defeat score sheet were left at the scene. Following the incident, New York police arrived at the scene immediately to conduct lockdown investigations, evidence collection, and statement recording, arresting criminal suspect Park Jae-hyuk on the spot. During initial interrogation, Park Jae-hyuk confessed to the crime of assaulting people out of emotional agitation due to his teammates' poor performance, bluntly stating throughout that 'carrying them was impossible, it was truly helpless,' with a surrender attitude that was 'fully resigned and utterly brazen.' The case is currently undergoing further investigation. According to the latest news, relevant South Korean authorities have officially submitted a request to the U.S. side for Park Jae-hyuk to be granted bail without trial, on the grounds that 'the skill gap across the team was too massive, the player losing emotional control was understandable, and it constitutes a passive overreaction.' This request has not yet been approved by the New York police. Police solemnly remind the public: Esports is meant for participation, and wins and losses are routine. Do not breed extreme emotions over match outcomes, let alone commit violent assaults. All illegal and radical acts will face severe legal sanctions. Please do not imitate radical behavior; watch and compete in sports rationally! New York City Police Department, Brooklyn Precinct
November 15, 2026

top.en:
Freshman year: WBG loses 0-3 to T1, T1 sweeps LPL 4-0
Sophomore year: BLG loses 2-3 to T1; that year we all believed you could do it, to cross the Demon King, but the Demon King was not old, his arrows still sharp.
Junior year: Worlds is held domestically; I thought, if there could be an LPL team in the finals, I'd definitely, definitely go watch it live to fulfill a dream of mine. But the finals were an LCK civil war, a reenactment of S7's Bird's Nest. That night, everyone thought the LPL was done for, and I thought so too.
Senior year: But today! BLG returns in full force, writing a different answer sheet. This time we avenged the shame of S13 when T1 swept the LPL, wiping away the disgrace by sweeping the LCK in turn. This time! We are the champions!!
Bin, you are the world's best top laner. You finally understand that you aren't the world's best top laner just because you call yourself one, but because everyone recognizes you as such! This time! You are the absolute world's best top laner!!
Xun, you are Captain China!! The absolute emperor crab of tournaments! Stealing objectives and ganking without a shred of hesitation, scaring T1 away with a reverse empty-city strategy! This time, you are the world's best jungler!!
Knight, you deserved a championship long ago. Your strength has finally claimed the honor that rightfully belongs to you today, and you are the well-deserved FMVP!
Viper, outsiders started off doubting you, but from the moment you revealed your mother's battle with cancer, everyone finally understood the immense pressure you carried to face all of this. Today's championship is the best gift for your mother; I hope she gets better soon and defeats the illness!
ON, your Rell regret in the river from 2024 was finally made up for today, and the tears of disappointment you shed then have transformed into the driving force moving forward today, shattering all doubts. You are the well-deserved Doctor O!!
Thank you BLG for making my four years of college not entirely about LCK. With no one to lift my soaring ambitions, I shall tread the snow straight to the mountain peak!!
BLG has written their own chapter, their story has concluded, and now it's our turn.
Borrowing a line from League of Legends, 'It's time for us to write our own chapter!' I too must win. When the roc rises with the wind in a single day, it soars ninety thousand li upwards!

top.zh:
真拿你没办法，坐好了，这里是纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心。北京时间11月15日凌晨三点，场馆灯火灼亮，全场的欢呼几乎要掀翻穹顶，这是S16全球总决赛最终的决战。
 屏幕前无数守到深夜的观众，心里都清楚这条道路有多疯狂。BLG从瑞士轮的悬崖边起步，一路闯关，先后斩落HLE、DK、T1，此刻站在最后一关，对手是GEN。在此之前，从来没有队伍能在同一届S赛里，连续碾碎四支LCK战队，一穿四，是只存在于幻想里的奇迹。
 他们身上驮着沉甸甸的过往：S14决赛擦肩而过的遗憾，屡次对阵LCK强队时背负的质疑，Knight沉淀许久的执念，Bin无数次绝境里站出来的担当。就算已经跨过三座大山，依旧很少有人敢相信，他们能走完这最后一步。外界的论调从未停歇，所有人都在等着GEN守住LCK最后的防线。
 技能碰撞的声响、指挥急促的呼喊、防御塔碎裂的轰鸣，填满了整场BO5。没有人敢提前松一口气，每一波团战都牵着亿万观众的心。
 四局鏖战落幕，比分停在掷地有声的3:1。
 BLG拿下了这场胜利。他们完成了史无前例的一穿四，冲破所有定论与枷锁，在巴克莱中心，捧起召唤师奖杯，写下属于LPL崭新的传奇。
top.en:
Can't do a thing with you, get comfortable, this is the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. 3:00 AM Beijing time on November 15, the venue is blazing with light, and the cheers of the crowd almost blow the roof off—this is the ultimate showdown of the S16 [~0:Worlds].
In front of screens across countless late nights, viewers knew deep down how insane this road was. BLG started from the edge of the [~1:Swiss stage] cliff, fighting their way through and successively cutting down HLE, DK, and T1, and at this moment standing at the final hurdle against GEN. Before this, no team had ever managed to consecutively crush four LCK squads in a single [~2:Worlds]; a run of four is a miracle that only exists in fantasy.
They carried heavy pasts on their backs: the regret of missing out in the S14 finals, the doubts shouldered when repeatedly facing LCK powerhouses, Knight's long-brewing obsession, and Bin stepping up in countless desperate situations. Even after crossing three giant mountains, very few dared to believe they could finish this final step. Outside talk never stopped, with everyone waiting for GEN to hold the LCK's final line of defense.
The sound of skill collisions, hurried shotcalling shouts, and the roar of crumbling turrets filled the entire BO5. No one dared to relax early, and every single teamfight tugged at the hearts of hundreds of millions of viewers.
Four grueling games came to a close, with the score resting at a resounding 3:1.
BLG claimed this victory. They completed an unprecedented gauntlet run, breaking through all conventional wisdom and shackles to hoist the Summoner's Cup at the Barclays Center and write a brand-new LPL legend.

notes.context: The League of Legends World Championship tournament.

Faker无论什么时候，在队伍陷入劣势时，都敢勇敢地站出来，做那个承担责任的人。哪怕失误了、送了、输了，也是我的责任；赢了，就和队友一起共享荣耀。他也因此在世界赛的舞台上贡献过无数绝地翻盘、力挽狂澜的名场面。

24年决赛第四场，一样的1:2落后，绝境中的塞拉斯一波毫不犹豫的开团，扭转局面。

虽然今年最后还是输了，但所有人都会说：Faker没输，Faker尽力了，Faker是站着倒下的。他无愧于这个游戏真正的GOAT。无论是对手还是他的粉丝，都会由衷地敬佩他。

这几场比赛，每一场Faker出的都是极限全输出装备，没有任何容错，没有一件保命装。直到T1水晶爆炸的那一刻之前，没有人敢松懈，没有人不怕Faker再来一波绝境翻盘。

而你呢，Chovy？

当你玩着阿卡丽，买了推推棒和金身，进场丢个烟雾弹，开个金身等死的时候，你在等谁呢？

上单Kiin吗？打野Canyon吗？这些都是生涯末期的老将了，而且他们今天已经尽力了，他们的上限就在这里了。

ADC Ruler吗？Ruler今天已经足够C了，可他只是个ADC啊！对面梦魇、卡牌、格温，各种冲阵、点控，你还要让他怎么样呢？

还是说，你是想让辅助璐璐上吗？

你在等谁呢？

top.en: No matter when, whenever the team falls into a deficit, Faker always dares to bravely step up and be the one who takes responsibility. Even if he messes up, ints, or loses, 'It's my responsibility'; if they win, they share the glory together with teammates. Because of this, he has contributed countless miraculous reverse sweeps and clutch moments on the Worlds stage. 23 Worlds semifinals against JDG: the Azir life-or-death shuffle to assassinate Ruler. 24 Worlds finals Game 4: down 1-2 just the same, a hesitation-free engage with Sylas in a desperate situation to turn the tide. This year's semifinals against BLG: still down 1-2, an extreme outplay on Akali that forcefully dragged back a 5,000 gold deficit. Even though they ended up losing this year, everyone will say: Faker didn't lose, Faker gave it his all, Faker went down fighting. He is truly deserving of being the GOAT of this game. Both opponents and his fans will sincerely admire him. In these matches, every single time Faker builds full-output glass cannon gear with zero margin for error and not a single defensive item. Until the moment the T1 Nexus explodes, no one dares to let down their guard, and no one isn't terrified of Faker pulling off another desperate reverse sweep. And what about you, Chovy? When you're playing Akali, buying Hextech Rocketbelt and Zhonya's, jumping in to drop a shroud, and popping Zhonya's while waiting to die, who are you waiting for? Who are you hoping will step up in your place to take responsibility and turn the tides? Top laner Kiin? Jungler Canyon? These are veterans at the end of their careers, and they already gave it their all today; their ceiling stops right here. ADC Ruler? Ruler carried hard enough today, but he's just an ADC! The enemy Nocturne, Twisted Fate, and Gwen are diving the backline with endless point-and-click crowd control, what more do you expect him to do? Or are you hoping support Lulu will step up? Who are you waiting for?

那是纽约巴克莱中心的赛场，一场足以载入英雄联盟史册的巅峰加冕。场馆万众屏息，喧嚣与沉寂反复更迭，每一次团战、每一回抢龙，都是追梦路上最滚烫的注脚。数年浮沉逐梦，无数次与冠军擦肩、无数轮遗憾离场，命运无数次将希望与重担，压在孤身前行的BLG肩上。

他们是驰骋赛场多年的劲旅，操作、团战、大赛底蕴早已炉火纯青。常年游走于生死团战，历经无数豪门对决与高压对局，他们早已习惯在绝境之中寻找破局的微光，是无数人心中永不低头的赛场利刃。

这条夺冠之路跌宕滚烫，布满荆棘与考验。瑞士轮的坚韧坚守，淘汰赛的绝境翻盘，对阵各路豪强的鏖战争锋，一路跌撞前行、逆势而上。褪去年少的急躁锋芒，如今的BLG沉稳笃定，没有花哨的操作，唯有千锤百炼的功底与千帆过尽的从容。每一次团战配合，都是重压之下的担当；每一次逆风翻盘，都是不甘遗憾的抗争。半决赛他们以3比1力克T1，打破了LPL在世界赛BO5中对T1长达十三年的不胜魔咒。

整场决赛胶着拉扯、惊心动魄，比分交替攀升，局势反复反转，所有人都在等待最终的结局。当最后一声推平基地的音效响彻场馆，所有焦灼与坚守终有归宿。尘埃落定，胜负落定！

历经漫长蛰伏，跨过无数失利低谷，熬过无数彻夜磨砺，BLG终于登顶纽约之巅，以3比1力克GEN，摘下梦寐以求的召唤师杯。压抑多年的遗憾尽数释然，长久的奔赴与坚守终得圆满。赛场欢呼轰然炸裂，聚光灯尽数汇聚在他们身上，LPL时隔五年再度捧起S赛冠军奖杯，昔日的争冠劲旅，终于加冕成王。

一枪一念，岁岁逐光。这不止是一场赛事的胜利，更是意志与热爱的终极凯旋。寥寥赛场对决，承载着他们多年的坚守与倔强，也圆满了无数追随者漫长的青春信仰，让所有踏过的荆棘、熬过的低谷，都化作登顶时最耀眼的荣光。
top.en: I really can't do anything about you, sit tight. That was the stage at the Barclays Center in New York, a peak coronation worthy of being recorded in the history of League of Legends. The venue held its breath, noise and silence alternated, every teamfight, every dragon steal, was the hottest footnote on the road to chasing dreams. After years of ups and downs, countless times of missing the championship, and countless rounds of regretful exits, fate pressed hope and heavy burdens onto the shoulders of BLG, who were walking alone. They are a veteran team that has been on the field for many years, their mechanics, teamfighting, and tournament foundation are already perfect. Having wandered through life-and-death teamfights for years, and experienced countless duels between giants and high-pressure games, they are already used to finding a glimmer of hope in desperate situations, and are the blades on the field that never bow their heads in the hearts of countless people. This road to the championship was bumpy and hot, full of thorns and tests. The persistence in the [~0:Swiss stage], the desperate comeback in the knockout stage, the fierce battles against all kinds of giants, stumbling forward, rising against the trend. Shedding the impetuous edge of youth, the current BLG is calm and determined, without flashy operations, only the foundation of thousands of tempers and the calmness of having seen it all. Every teamfight cooperation is a responsibility under pressure; every comeback against the wind is a resistance against unwillingness and regret. In the semi-finals, they defeated T1 3-1, breaking the 13-year curse of the LPL's inability to beat T1 in a BO5 at Worlds. The entire final was tense and thrilling, the score climbed alternately, the situation reversed repeatedly, and everyone was waiting for the final outcome. When the sound of the final base destruction echoed through the venue, all the anxiety and persistence finally had a destination. The dust settled, the winner was decided! After a long period of dormancy, crossing countless low valleys of failure, and enduring countless nights of training, BLG finally reached the top of New York, defeating GEN 3-1 to win the Summoner's Cup they dreamed of. The regrets of many years were all relieved, and the long-term pursuit and persistence were finally fulfilled. The cheers on the field exploded, and the spotlights gathered on them. The LPL lifted the [~1:S-tournament] championship trophy again after five years, and the former championship contender finally crowned as king. Every shot and every thought, chasing the light year after year. This is not just a victory in a tournament, but the ultimate triumph of will and love. The few duels on the field carry their years of persistence and stubbornness, and also fulfill the long-term youth faith of countless followers, making all the thorns they stepped on and the low valleys they endured turn into the most dazzling glory when reaching the peak.

In 23, Orianna redeems herself with a three-man shockwave, Ruler steps in to clean up, thinking they're about to win, only for Faker's Azir to predict the flash and shuffle him away.
In 24, double suns in the sky rekindle his confidence, only to get reverse-swept by Sylas, missing Rell Qs, and Faker's immortal Galio shatters his championship dream.
Then an Ezreal ultimate acts as a transition animation, altering the timeline to cut to 26 where Demonic Knight's Swain pulls three people and knocks Galio airborne, ON's spicy-hot-pot charm hits three, defeating T1 twice and breaking his mental demons.
Finally former teammate Ruler emerges to stop them, a Twisted Fate gold card fills the screen, and right after cutting the camera they lift the trophy and win the championship

top.zh:
五年无冠海云黄，万里中原半夕阳。 春到南溟折桂返，金杯初照浦江长。

五月三韩战五场，功亏一篑大田旁。 七月西戎青旗折，归来帐下议更张。

副车初出试霜刃，数战不利军心震。 夜半将军自上书，明朝复领前锋印。

秋来决战沪江滨，同袍一战失龙鳞。 屈居次席出函谷，回首故园泪沾巾。

瑞士轮前风色恶，初战折锋众心愕。 同袍再战又相残，二胜二负悬一发。

背水一战气如虹，连下两城势若龙。 八强三捷青旗倒，四强一鼓旧王空。

上将三度临绝顶，前两度兮皆断肠。 白虎低头献金印，四破韩营天下扬。

五年饮恨今朝雪，十三旧捷一夜亡。 黄浦潮生连天起，尽是少年凯歌章。
top.en: Five years without a title, the sea clouds are yellow, ten thousand miles of the Central Plains in the setting sun. Spring comes to the Southern Sea, returning with the laurel, the golden cup shines on the long Pujiang River. In May, the three Han nations fought five games, falling short near Daejeon. In July, the Western barbarians' blue flags were broken, returning to the camp to discuss changes. The deputy chariot first tested the frosty blade, several unfavorable battles shook the army's heart. At midnight, the general wrote a letter himself, and the next morning he led the vanguard seal again. In autumn, the decisive battle on the banks of the Shanghai River, the comrades lost their dragon scales in one battle. Residing in second place, leaving the Hangu Pass, looking back at the hometown, tears stained the handkerchief. Before the [~0:Swiss stage], the wind was evil, and the first battle broke the blade, shocking everyone. The comrades fought again and killed each other, two wins and two losses hanging by a thread. Fighting with one's back to the river, the spirit was like a rainbow, taking two cities in a row, the momentum like a dragon. Three victories in the quarterfinals, the blue flags fell, one drum in the semifinals, the old king was empty. The general reached the peak three times, the first two times were heartbreaking. The White Tiger bowed its head and offered the golden seal, breaking the Korean camp four times, famous throughout the world. Five years of drinking hatred, today it is washed away, thirteen old victories died in one night. The Huangpu tide rises to the sky, all are the songs of victory of the youth.

top.zh:
真拿你没办法，坐好了，这里是纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心。北京时间11月15日凌晨三点，场馆灯火灼亮，全场的欢呼几乎要掀翻穹顶，这是S16全球总决赛最终的决战。
 屏幕前无数守到深夜的观众，心里都清楚这条道路有多疯狂。BLG从瑞士轮的悬崖边起步，一路闯关，先后斩落HLE、DK、T1，此刻站在最后一关，对手是GEN。在此之前，从来没有队伍能在同一届S赛里，连续碾碎四支LCK战队，一穿四，是只存在于幻想里的奇迹。
 他们身上驮着沉甸甸的过往：S14决赛擦肩而过的遗憾，屡次对阵LCK强队时背负的质疑，Knight沉淀许久的执念，Bin无数次绝境里站出来的担当。就算已经跨过三座大山，依旧很少有人敢相信，外界的论调从未停歇，所有人都在等着GEN守住LCK最后的防线。
 技能碰撞的声响、指挥急促的呼喊、防御塔碎裂的轰鸣。没有人敢提前松一口气，每一波团战都牵着亿万观众的心。
 四局鏖战落幕，比分停在掷地有声的3:1。
 BLG拿下了这场胜利。HLE、DK、T1、GEN，四支LCK强队尽数败于他们手下。他们完成了史无前例的一穿四，冲破所有定论与枷锁，在巴克莱中心，捧起召唤师奖杯，写下属于LPL崭新的传奇。
top.en:
I really can't do anything with you. Sit tight, we are at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. It's 3:00 AM Beijing time on November 15th, the arena lights are blazing, and the cheers are almost blowing the roof off. This is the final showdown of the S16 [~0:Worlds].
Countless viewers staying up late in front of their screens know how crazy this road has been. BLG started from the edge of the cliff in the [~1:Swiss stage], fighting their way through, taking down HLE, DK, and T1. Now they stand at the final gate, facing GEN. Before this, no team had ever crushed four LCK teams in a single [~0:Worlds] tournament. A 'sweep of four' is a miracle that only existed in fantasies.
They carry heavy history on their backs: the regrets of missing out in the S14 finals, the doubts they faced every time they played LCK powerhouses, Knight's long-held obsession, and Bin's determination to stand up in desperate situations time and time again. Even after crossing three mountains, few dared to believe. The outside narrative never stopped; everyone was waiting for GEN to hold the final line of defense for the LCK.
The sound of skills colliding, the urgent shouts of shot-calling, the roar of turrets crumbling. No one dared to relax early; every teamfight held the hearts of hundreds of millions of viewers.
After four grueling games, the score stopped at a resounding 3:1.
BLG took the victory. HLE, DK, T1, GEN—four LCK powerhouses all fell to them. They completed an unprecedented sweep of four, breaking through all conclusions and shackles, lifting the Summoner's Cup at the Barclays Center, and writing a brand new legend for the LPL.

S16决赛，BLG对阵GEN，最终比分3:1，让一追三拿下召唤师杯，完成史诗级一穿四！
 
先看这条不可思议的征程：从瑞士轮生死局开始，BLG先是2-0拿下HLE，拿到八强门票；八强3-0横扫DK；半决赛3-1掀翻T1，击碎对手冲击四连冠的梦想；决赛再斩GEN，把本届全部四支LCK队伍一一淘汰，一穿四封神，这是独一份的传奇之路。
 
回到决赛四局对局：
第一局GEN率先发力，Ruler飞机打出压制，GEN先下一城，BLG暂时落后。
第二局Xun选出冥犬，野区节奏完全带动全队，团战连续撕开GEN防线，稳稳扳回一分。
第三局Viper岩雀输出拉满，ON的开团屡屡建功，BLG拿下赛点，距离冠军只差一局。
第四局决胜局开局并不顺利，Ruler霞早早拿到线杀，GEN手握优势。但BLG稳住心态，抓住机会大龙团打出完美团战，Xun梦魇果断进场，Bin格温、Knight卡牌兜底配合，一波拉开巨大经济差，一路推平基地。
 
这是BLG队史第一个S赛冠军，也是LPL时隔五年再度捧杯。Knight终结了韩国中单连续13届拿下S赛冠军的记录，Bin成为LPL第一位上路大满贯选手。
我们是冠军！🏆
top.en:
Guess I have no choice, buckle up.
S16 Finals, BLG vs GEN, final score 3:1. They drop the first game then reverse sweep to take the Summoner's Cup, completing an epic [~0:sweep of four]! Look at this incredible journey: starting from the [~1:Swiss stage] elimination matches, BLG first took down HLE 2-0 to secure a spot in the quarterfinals; swept DK 3-0 in the quarters; took down T1 3-1 in the semis, shattering their dream of a four-peat; then took down GEN in the finals, eliminating all four LCK teams this year one by one. A legendary path like no other. Back to the four games of the finals:
Game 1: GEN struck first, Ruler's Corki dominated, GEN took the lead, BLG trailed.
Game 2: Xun picked Kindred, his jungle tempo carried the team, tearing through GEN's defense in teamfights, and they leveled the score.
Game 3: Viper's Taliyah output was maxed out, ON's engages were clutch, BLG took match point, just one game away from the title.
Game 4: The deciding game didn't start well, Ruler's Xayah got an early lane kill, GEN held the advantage. But BLG kept their cool, seized the opportunity for a perfect teamfight at Baron, Xun's Nocturne engaged decisively, Bin's Gwen and Knight's Twisted Fate cleaned up, opening a massive gold lead and pushing straight to the base. This is BLG's first [~2:Worlds] title in team history, and the first time the LPL has lifted the trophy in five years. Knight ended the 13-tournament streak of Korean mid laners winning Worlds, and Bin became the first LPL player to complete a career Grand Slam in the top lane.
We are the champions! 🏆

notes.context: Refers to a team defeating four consecutive opponents from the same region or bracket.
The Swiss-system tournament format used in the early stages of the League of Legends World Championship.
Common Chinese shorthand for the League of Legends World Championship.

thread.zh:
真拿你没办法，坐好了，这里是纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心，场馆灯火灼亮，屏幕前无数守到深夜的观众，心里都清楚这条道路有多疯狂。BLG从瑞士轮的悬崖边起步，一路闯关，先后斩落HLE、DK、T1，此刻站在最后一关，对手是GEN。在此之前，从来没有队伍能在同一届S赛里，连续碾碎四支LCK战队，一穿四，是只存在于幻想里的奇迹。
 他们身上驮着沉甸甸的过往：S14决赛擦肩而过的遗憾，屡次对阵LCK强队时背负的质疑，Knight沉淀许久的执念，Bin无数次绝境里站出来的担当。就算已经跨过三座大山，依旧很少有人敢相信，他们能走完这最后一步。外界的论调从未停歇，所有人都在等着GEN守住LCK最后的防线。
 技能碰撞的声响、指挥急促的呼喊、防御塔碎裂的轰鸣，填满了整场BO5。没有人敢提前松一口气，每一波团战都牵着亿万观众的心。
 四局鏖战落幕，比分停在掷地有声的3:1。
 BLG拿下了这场胜利。HLE、DK、T1、GEN，四支LCK强队尽数败于他们手下。他们完成了史无前例的一穿四，冲破所有定论与枷锁，在巴克莱中心，捧起召唤师奖杯，写下属于LPL崭新的传奇。
thread.en: I really can't with you. Sit tight, this is the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. The arena is ablaze with light, and countless viewers staying up late in front of their screens all know how crazy this road has been. Starting from the edge of the cliff in the [~0:Swiss stage], BLG fought their way through, successively taking down HLE, DK, and T1. At this moment, they stand at the final hurdle against GEN. Before this, no team had ever managed to crush four LCK teams consecutively in the same [~1:Worlds]; a [~2:gauntlet sweep] of four is a miracle that only exists in fantasy. They carry the heavy weight of the past: the regret of narrowly missing out in the S14 finals, the doubts shouldered through repeated clashes against LCK powerhouses, Knight's long-settled determination, and Bin stepping up in countless desperate moments to shoulder the burden. Even after crossing three great mountains, very few people still dare to believe they can walk this final step. Outside voices have never stopped, with everyone waiting for GEN to hold the LCK's final line of defense. The sound of skills clashing, sharp calls from shotcallers, and the roar of crumbling turrets filled the entire BO5. No one dared to let their guard down early, and every single teamfight gripped the hearts of hundreds of millions of viewers. Four grueling games came to an end, with the score resting at a resounding 3:1. BLG took the victory. HLE, DK, T1, GEN—four LCK powerhouses all fell beneath them. They completed an unprecedented sweep of four, shattering all fixed conclusions and shackles, holding the Summoner's Goblet high at the Barclays Center to write a brand-new LPL legend.

notes.context: The Swiss-system tournament stage of the League of Legends World Championship.
The League of Legends World Championship.
Sweeping through four consecutive opponents in a knockout bracket.

top.en: As someone who has watched BLG [~0:all the way] since 2023, I am endlessly grateful for everything Elk has done for BLG. Yes, you could say he threw in 2024 and 2025. Indeed, he has a lot of small flaws, he isn't a textbook ADC [~1:template], and he loves to backseat shotcall. I admit all these issues, and I understand why some people might hate him. But I've always felt that without Elk, there wouldn't be the BLG of today—and that statement applies just as much to him as it does to every single player who has contributed to BLG. Under the blinding light of a championship, past achievements and honors might seem as insignificant as butterflies, but we cannot ignore the efforts of every player who ever suited up for BLG. I sincerely thank the six best guys of 2026: Bin, Flandre, Xun, Knight, Viper, and ON, but I am equally thankful for Elk, Yagao, Beichuan, Shadow, Wei, LvMao, Tabe, and Daeny. Without any single one of you, BLG might have branched off into a different timeline. If you happen to scroll past this on Hupu, I want to say you've all worked hard. I hope that whether you're still on the team, have left, retired, or changed roles, you all have a better tomorrow. I also hope everyone stops [~2:liquidating] the players who used to bleed for BLG; without you guys, there wouldn't be BLG's championship. Of course, that pigwei piece of work is the exception, I am never thanking you. I'll hate your guts no matter where you go, you motherfucker.

notes.context: Describes following a team continuously over a long period.
Refers to an ideal standard or blueprint for a player role.
Fan slang for relentlessly digging up and criticizing a player's past mistakes.

thread.en: I feel like swapping Akali for Lissandra would have worked. Lissandra's CC could combo with Pantheon's ult to catch people out; just one or two successful ganks would make the game much easier. Akali building defensive items means she can't catch anyone. As for Canyon's 'return to basics', I don't believe that if Lissandra called out for him to come close and then locked someone down, Canyon wouldn't have used his ult. Lissandra is also more useful in teamfights. Even if you're too scared to engage or dictate the pace, playing for counter-engage is still better than a cowardly Akali.

top.en: Essentially the jungler and mid laner were non-factors, mid lane was invisible, and the coach got out-drafted. Let's discuss this rationally: in the last game, why not give Kiin Aurora? The options outside were Ornn, Sion, Kennen, Aatrox. I thought, would picking Mordekaiser top be better? Given the bot lane had an advantage, Pantheon could path top—not necessarily to get a kill or burn a Flash, but at least to help Mordekaiser push a wave and recall, making the laning phase a bit more comfortable. Plus, in teamfights, he can isolate someone and peel, safely passing the ball to Ruler. I also thought of other champions: Kennen feels useless once hit by a Twisted Fate Gold Card, and Sett has short range. Is there any merit to BLG picking Nocturne or Twisted Fate first? But they are too weak and would get bullied in lane. If they picked Maokai top, maybe build Echoes and turtle up for teamfight engage? But that doesn't seem to have a laning advantage either. It seems Kiin had no champions left to pick. If you first-pick Gwen, you'll just get red-faced.

top.en: This year's Worlds was too late and boring. I want to ask, are there any FPS tournaments to recommend where they sell titles, spend money to buy spots, decorate four luxury toilets, invite foreign friends to make a huge mess, have fan clubs kowtow to thank active players, where the strongest international skill is post-match rating, fans have more excuses than the coach has tactics, and even when they get beaten like a soft kitten, you're not allowed to criticize them? Where winning double-digit points makes them the pride of the region, and if they lose, fans switch to insulting the 'Asian physique'? Where even TES would be considered 'dying standing up' as the king of international play, and the 1st seed gets kicked to death at home on National Day by an outside region?

top.zh: 说实话，如果BLG真的能一穿四LCK夺冠，那这座奖杯的含金量，我甚至不知道该用什么语言去形容。我们见过太多LPL倒在LCK面前的夜晚，见过太多满怀希望的出征，最后却只能用一句“技不如人”草草收场。LCK曾经像一座横亘在我们面前的大山，我们翻过一座，前面却还有另一座。可这一次，BLG没有等别人替他们扫清障碍，而是选择一座一座地翻过去。最让我佩服的不是他们击败了多少支韩国队，而是他们几乎以一己之力，扛起了整个赛区这些年来的不甘。 四支LCK队伍，四场必须跨越的考验，从来没有所谓的好签，也没有谁替他们铺好通往决赛的路。如果最终真的能站上世界之巅，那这就不只是一段夺冠故事，更像是一封写给过去所有遗憾的回信。以前我们总在盼着有人能翻过那座山，而今天，他们告诉所有人：山不需要绕过去，也可以一座一座踏过去！
top.en: To be honest, if BLG can really run the gauntlet past four LCK teams to win the championship, I wouldn't even know what words to use to describe the gold content of this trophy. We've seen too many nights of LPL falling before the LCK, seen too many hopeful campaigns end in a hasty retreat of "just simply inferior in skill." The LCK used to stand like a giant mountain before us; we'd climb one, only to find another waiting ahead. But this time, BLG didn't wait for others to clear the obstacles for them—they chose to climb over them one by one. What impresses me most isn't how many Korean teams they defeated, but how they single-handedly carried all the heartbreak and unfulfilled ambitions of our entire region over these past years. Four LCK teams, four mandatory trials to cross, with no lucky draws or paved roads leading to the finals. If they can finally stand on top of the world, this won't just be a championship story; it'll feel like a reply letter written to every regret from the past. We used to always hope someone could climb that mountain, and today, they're telling everyone: you don't have to walk around mountains, you can trample over them one by one!

Both venues can hold 18,000 people, whereas whenever his performance isn't outright criminal, the venues are never that big. Today's venue was packed with people and he instantly folded. He didn't face any teams putting pressure on him before the finals, and teams like IG and LGD have terrible laning anyway, but the moment you play against BLG your true colors are exposed.  屏幕前无数守到深夜的观众，心里都清楚这条道路有多疯狂。BLG从瑞士轮的悬崖边起步，一路闯关，先后斩落HLE、DK、T1，此刻站在最后一关，对手是GEN。在此之前，从来没有队伍能在同一届S赛里，连续碾碎四支LCK战队，一穿四，是只存在于幻想里的奇迹。

 四局鏖战落幕，比分停在掷地有声的3:1。
 BLG拿下了这场胜利。HLE、DK、T1、GEN，四支LCK强队尽数败于他们手下。他们完成了史无前例的一穿四，冲破所有定论与枷锁，在巴克莱中心，捧起召唤师奖杯，写下属于LPL崭新的传奇。
thread.en: There's nothing I can do with you. Get comfortable, we are at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. It's 3:00 AM on November 15th, Beijing time. The arena is ablaze with bright lights, and the cheers from the crowd are about to blow the roof off. This is the ultimate showdown of the [~0:S-n] World Championship. In front of screens everywhere, countless viewers staying up late know damn well how insane this road has been. Starting from the edge of the cliff in the [~1:Swiss stage], BLG fought their way through, successively striking down HLE, DK, and T1, and now they stand at the final gate against GEN. Before this, no team had ever managed to consecutively crush four LCK teams in the same [~2:Worlds]; a 1-v-4 gauntlet run is a miracle that only exists in fantasies. They carry heavy baggage from the past: the heart-wrenching regrets of the S14 finals, the doubts cast upon them every time they faced LCK powerhouses, Knight's long-brewing obsession, and Bin stepping up as the hero in countless desperate moments. Even after crossing three giant mountains, very few people dared to believe they could finish this final step. Outside noise never stopped, and everyone was waiting for GEN to hold the last line of defense for the LCK. Four grueling games concluded, the score resting at a resounding 3:1. BLG claimed this victory. HLE, DK, T1, GEN—four LCK powerhouses all fell beneath them. They completed an unprecedented clean sweep of all four LCK teams, broke through every verdict and shackle, lifted the Summoner's Cup at the Barclays Center, and wrote a brand-new LPL legend.

notes.context: The 16th League of Legends World Championship tournament.

BLG definitely secured massive advantages during the laning phase, but they lost every single teamfight and let the enemy stall out their rapid dragon pacing. Once that first teamfight crumbled, the rest of the game was unplayable. But you can't entirely blame BLG either; it's mostly because while Gen.G's laning might be questionable, their teamfighting is truly unbeatable.
